corsAllowAll.name: Disable CORS restriction
corsAllowAll.description: Adds Access-Control-Allow-* headers to matching responses to unblock CORS during local debugging. Change the match pattern to your own API address.

disableCache.name: Disable cache
disableCache.description: Adds no-cache Cache-Control headers to both request and response so you always get the latest resource. Change the match pattern to your target address.

forceHttps.name: Force HTTPS
forceHttps.description: Redirects matching http requests to the same address over https. Matches all http requests by default.

mobileUaIos.name: Mobile UA · iPhone
mobileUaIos.description: Changes the User-Agent to iOS Safari so the site returns its mobile page. Change the match pattern to your target site.

mobileUaAndroid.name: Mobile UA · Android
mobileUaAndroid.description: Changes the User-Agent to Android Chrome so the site returns its mobile page. Change the match pattern to your target site.

isoTime.label: ISO time
isoTime.description: Current time as an ISO 8601 string

randomInt.label: Random integer
randomInt.description: Random integer; argument sets the inclusive range [min, max], defaults to 0-100

randomString.label: Random string
randomString.description: Random alphanumeric string; argument sets the length, defaults to 8

ruleEditor.name: Rule name
ruleEditor.selectActionHint: Check a "{{groupTitle}}" action to start configuring

actionDescription.redirect: Forward the request to another address
actionDescription.injectParams: Append or override query string params
actionDescription.modifyHeaders: Add, remove, or modify request/response headers
actionDescription.mockResponse: Intercept the request and return a custom response
actionDescription.delay: Inject latency and bandwidth limits into the request
actionDescription.modifyRequestBody: Rewrite the request body before it's sent
actionDescription.insertScript: Inject JS / CSS by page URL

dnr.title: Network layer
dnr.hint: Applies to all requests (including navigation and static assets), but can't read the request body
dnr.note: Block / Redirect / Inject params are mutually exclusive; Modify headers can be combined

pagePatch.title: Page patch
pagePatch.hint: Only applies to fetch / XHR made by page scripts; can read and write the request body and response
pagePatch.note: Mock response / Throttle / Modify body can be combined; Insert script must be used alone

validation.bodyMethodsRequired: Modifying the body requires POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE / OPTIONS
validation.bodyMatchValueRequired: Body match value cannot be empty
validation.exclusiveDnrActions: Block, Redirect, and Inject params are mutually exclusive
validation.redirectUrlAbsolute: Redirect target must be an absolute address, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4317/api/redirect-target.json
validation.mockStatusCodeRange: Mock status code must be between 100 and 599
validation.dynamicMockFunctionRequired: Dynamic mock function cannot be empty
validation.requestBodyContentRequired: Request body content cannot be empty
validation.requestBodyFunctionRequired: Request body function cannot be empty
